description: Suno Studio effect. Close-mic 'in your ear' vocal voicing. Adds air, low-mid warmth, and a gentle presence bump, then blends with the dry signal. Apply to rendered vocal audio inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Close-mic 'in your ear' vocal voicing. Adds air, low-mid warmth, and a gentle presence bump, then blends with the dry signal.

air.description: High-shelf lift near 10kHz for open, breathy top end.
air.label: Air

warmth.description: Low-shelf warmth near 250Hz for body and closeness.
warmth.label: Warmth

presence.description: Peaking presence bump near 4kHz for forward intelligibility.
presence.label: Presence

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
